what: How intent flows from the founder's vision to done, as a state machine. States are the stages of docs/specs/2026-10-31-work-orders.md; each edge names its gate, its decider (machine/model/judgment) and the class that acts (angel or legion). Judged by bin/intent-flow check and tests/test_intent_flow.py. Done means operational (AGENTS.md section 3), never merged.

edges.gate: one sentence with its source
intent recorded; no duplicate layer exists (growmos query, rg)
evidence measured this run; unknowns named
BDD feature exists and fails first
bin/decision-frame returns PROCEED
decision-frame returns ESCALATE
decision-frame returns REFUSE (a law, or over the spend ceiling)
claim open, paths free of overlap
patch built against a named base
digest recorded, paths declared, dry-run passes
order landed or author's claim; runner verifies the seal
checks pass; commit through hooks; lane pushed
seal, apply or check failed: back to an angel to issue a new order
Greenlane proves green on top of main
Greenlane red or conflicting: reason read from the head status, reissue
a real production measurement on the founder's surface
outcome graded by a collector that is not the executor; claim released; journal written
estate_health entry for the capability is green
founder answers the one decision message; the answer is recorded as the decision
founder-surface path: the lane waits for the founder door
founder approves the held lane
founder declines; timeout leaves status quo, never approves
reissue budget spent: the same order class failed too many times
landed but the production measurement is red: reissue a corrective order

feedback.what: Error correction built into the flow. Every failure edge carries a cause class; each class has a correction at the right level, a record, and an escalation when the correction does not hold.

seal-digest-mismatch.correction: rebuild the order from the source commit; never edit the patch

patch-conflict.correction: rebase the work onto current main and rebuild the order

check-failed.correction: angel reads the failing check output, fixes the work, reissues

lane-red.correction: read the greenlane commit status on the lane head, fix, reissue

law-refused.correction: fix the plan so it does not need the forbidden step; never route around the door

production-red.correction: issue a corrective order against the measured failure

repeated-cause.correction: two failures of one cause class in 14 days: add the gate, test or probe that catches the class (J2), in the same claim

wrong-decision.correction: a graded outcome contradicts a decision: feed it to the decision record; the confidence floor is revisited only after enough graded outcomes

unknown.correction: classify before retrying; an unclassified failure is not retried blindly

chain.what: The tree of command. Each role has one parent. A failure goes UP one rung at a time, to the issuer that sealed the order; a correction comes back DOWN as a new order (to legion) or a brief (to angels). Roles are classes, not names; the names in 'examples' are the coordinators the founder has named in this engagement.

examples: the model or person that built the order

issuer-angel.after: reissue_budget failures of one cause class

coordinator-angel.after: a repeated cause or two issuers failing the same class

final-angel.after: value-tradeoff, irreversible, novel, or a decider contradicted by graded outcomes

downward.to_legion: a new sealed order, never advice
downward.to_angels: a brief carrying the lesson at claim-open

ranks.what: The legion's ranking, in the Goetic manner: rank fixes authority and reach, never the other way round. Authority is rigid and declared here; coordination is distributed through claims (no central dispatcher). Rank is earned from graded outcomes, so promotion and demotion are rules over evidence. The numeric parameters are PROPOSED and unmeasured; they are placeholders to be set from the first graded runs.

shadow.may: dry-run only; produces a lane that is never landed and is graded against what an angel would have done
shadow.enters: every new runner, model or harness starts here

knight.may: push a lane for low-blast paths

marquis.may: push a lane for code and catalog paths with declared checks

duke.may: push a lane that touches a critical service or founder surface; the lane is HELD for the founder door

promotion.rule: promoted one rank when the last N orders at the current rank each landed, reached operating, and none breached its seal; N is proposed (10) and unmeasured
promotion.evidence: graded by a collector that is not the runner; the runner never writes its own grade
promotion.never: a rank is never granted by a runner or an issuer to itself, and never by a model's say-so

demotion.rule: demoted to shadow on any seal breach (applied something other than the sealed patch, wrote outside declared paths, or reported a result the evidence contradicts); one rank on a red lane after landing
demotion.shadow_return: re-entry needs the same promotion evidence as a new runner

coordination.style: distributed, by claim: a runner takes the next order its rank allows by opening a claim with a heartbeat; a lapsed heartbeat releases it. There is no central scheduler to fail.
rigid: the founder door for held lanes
